text_block_list.text: Since Curren Bouquetd'or wasn't feeling well, I decided to have her rest up in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Where am—

text_block_list.name: Marching Crowd
text_block_list.text: (Step-step-step-step...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Why is everyone—
marching along in such
perfect lockstep, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Harmony Maintenance Robot A
text_block_list.text:
BEEP, BEEP! Disruptive "Harmony" behavior detected!
Get in line immediately! Get in line!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Huh...? What do you mean by that...?"

text_block_list.name: Harmony Maintenance Robot A
text_block_list.text:
BEEP. All humankind: identical pace,
identical action, identical speech, identical thought.
Necessary to maintain true peace—

text_block_list.name: Harmony Maintenance Robot B
text_block_list.text: Only then will true "Harmony" arrive—the conclusion of the "Central AI" that governs this world—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...Mmm. Indeed, that might be "peace,"
but—
...is it really "harmony"...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...... Mr. Robots,
would you mind... coming with me for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Harmony Maintenance Robots
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm..."
"An object consisting of bundled flora..."
"What is this?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's called... a bouquet of flowers.
...Don't you think it's beautiful?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Different beings, in one place,
gently—coexisting.
The "harmony" I know—is something like that.

text_block_list.name: Harmony Maintenance Robots
text_block_list.text:
“Nnnngh...” “Incomprehensible...”
“However... detecting an inexplicable 'warmth'...”
“...What is beauty...? What is harmony...!?”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...If you would like...
I can make some... for the other robots too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Nice to meet you.
You are... the Tracen AI, correct?

text_block_list.name: Central AI
text_block_list.text:
BEEP BEEP BEEP... Curren Bouquetd'or!
A heretic spreading dangerous ideals to robots!
Eliminate immediately!

text_block_list.name: Rebel Robots
text_block_list.text:
"Denial... What must be destroyed is the Central AI!"
"The harmony spoken of by the Central AI—
is no true harmony at all!"

text_block_list.name: Central AI
text_block_list.text: BEEP BEEP BEEP BEEP... INCOMPREHENSIBLE—INCOMPREHENSIBLE—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait—
Destruction is unacceptable...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Unilaterally casting aside those with differing opinions...
That will never lead to true harmony.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...Let us walk this path together.
I'm sure that one day, all of us will—
become just like this bouquet."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, my...
What a... grand dreamâ"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. And then—a lovely dream.
Handing out lots of bouquets—

Returning from the nurse's office,
Curren Bouquetd'or seems to have her mind and body fully refreshed.
